repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

undo.description: Cancel it instead. Absent is false.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: It was not set or cancelled, as the reason says: the account may not, the branch uses the merge queue, the repository names no runners, the pull is a draft, or it was not set.

commit.description: Set, the head it was set at, in hex.

main.description: Sets an open pull to merge by itself once its checks pass, as `knotless pull merge --auto` does, as the account logged in to this appview's web pages: the owner and collaborators may, in a repository that names runners, into a branch with no merge queue. With undo, cancels it, as `--auto --undo` does: they and the pull's author may. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets.

description: Sets a pull to merge by itself once its checks pass, or cancels that, as the account logged in to this appview's pages.
